title: Bug: wc_RsaEncryptSize error return not checked
description: In wp11_backend_soft.c, wc_RsaEncryptSize() returns -1 on error (invalid key), but the call site casts the return value to word32 without checking for negative. -1 cast to word32 becomes 0xFFFFFFFFu (4 GiB), which is then used as the expected signature length or buffer size, causing incorrect behavior. Fix: check the return value before casting. If negative, return an appropriate error.
